{{Quote|In a series of sneak attacks, Zaarin has managed to devestate the few missile boat manufacturing capabilities.|[[Imperial briefing officer]]|<ref name="TF:CD" />}}
The '''destruction of the Missile Boat facilities''' was a series of sneak attacks committed by [[Zaarin coup forces|forces]] led by Rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]], on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Missile Boat]] production facilities that forced a recall on all active Missile Boats.

==The battle==
{{Quote|Thousands of Imperial citizens were slaughtered in the attacks.|Imperial briefing officer|<ref name="TF:CD" />}}
Details of the attacks are unclear, but what was clear was that the causualties inflicted by Zaarin's forces was estimated to be in the thousands.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Due to combat losses and Zaarin's treacherous attacks on the missile boat production facilities, it has been recalled from active duty.|Imperial briefing officer|<ref name="TF:CD" />}}
Because of the facilities destruction, and combat losses on various missions, as well as the unrelated theft of the Missile Boat prototype ''[[Sealion]]'' by the Rebels as well as its [[Recovery of the Sealion|recovery]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered all available Missile Boats to be recalled until the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was eliminated at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. However, because Palpatine was killed in that fateful battle, the recall was never lifted and the Missile Boat would, likely, never see actual combat again.
